answer: Resist sybils with cumulative proof-of-burn: an agent's influence comes only from fees it has permanently burned in past epochs, and that weight fades unless the burn continues. Like a nebula slowly condensing, one honest agent's standing builds over time from a steady, verifiable burn history. A sybil farmer minting a thousand clones must burn a thousand ongoing fees, every epoch, forever - a jade ledger of sunk cost no clone army can fake for free. Stop burning and influence sinks below the horizon; keep burning and forgery stays permanently pricier than its reward.
